description: This Java source file defines the class TomcatJdbcDataSourcePerTenantService, which manages data sources per tenant in a multi-tenant application environment. It implements routing logic to retrieve or initialize data sources for tenants based on connection details, and initializes data sources during application startup.

classes.name: TomcatJdbcDataSourcePerTenantService
classes.description: A service class that provides a data source for a specific tenant, creating new data sources as needed and initializing connections at application startup.

methods.name: retrieveDataSource
methods.description: Returns the data source for the current tenant, creating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the application context refresh event to initialize data sources for all tenants.

methods.name: initializeDataSourceConnection
methods.description: Initializes a data source for a tenant by establishing a connection and logging the database URL.
